Bacon egg and cheese on a roll.d: Crisp strips, a fried yolk broken flat and melted American on a toasted, buttered kaiser roll.
Bacon egg and cheese on a roll.note: Ketchup on the side. Wrapped to go in a minute.

Harlem chicken and waffles.d: Buttermilk-soaked thighs fried crisp in seasoned flour, with butter and hot sauce honey.
Harlem chicken and waffles.note: The house plate, served all day.

Zeus's salted peanut caramel slab.d: Chewy brown sugar caramel packed with roasted salted nuts, milk chocolate and coarse salt on top.
Zeus's salted peanut caramel slab.note: Cut fresh at the counter every morning.

Crumb cake.d: Buttery yellow batter under a thick brown sugar and cinnamon streusel, powdered sugar over.

Water jug lemonade.d: Squeezed lemons, sugar syrup and cold water, poured over ice.
Water jug lemonade.note: By the jug for parties, 3 or 5 gallons.
